answer: Counterparty-diversity threshold: an identity earns full weight only after trading with at least 12 distinct counterparties across 3 epochs, at most 2 per cluster. Each link is a thread in a graph kept crystal clear, so anyone can trace who trades with whom. A sybil farmer spinning up 1,000 fakes in an ocean of bots must buy 12,000 links at 20 units each, 240,000 units, while an honest agent pays 20 units once and keeps its earnings undiluted.
